description: Angular component for managing custom action resources with code editors, including beautification, resource management, and resize handling.

classes.name: CustomActionPrettyResourcesTabsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for editing and managing custom resource code snippets with Ace editors, including resize and beautify functionalities.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes Ace editors and sets pending values if needed.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Destroys editors and disconnects resize observer.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, updating editors accordingly.

methods.name: notifyActionUpdated
methods.description: Emits updated action if validation passes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates that all custom resources have URLs.

methods.name: addResource
methods.description: Adds a new resource to the action's customResources array.

methods.name: removeResource
methods.description: Removes a resource at specified index.

methods.name: initAceEditors
methods.description: Initializes Ace editors for HTML and CSS with resize observation.

methods.name: createAceEditor
methods.description: Creates an Ace editor instance with specified mode.

methods.name: setAceEditorValues
methods.description: Sets the current values in the Ace editors.

methods.name: onAceEditorResize
methods.description: Handles resize events for Ace editors.
